name: Emote
long_description: Emote is an AI-enabled platform that helps schools scale real-time, individualized student support without adding staff. Co-built alongside educators and interventionists, Emote continuously analyzes behavioral and social-emotional data to surface early indicators of need and deliver actionable insights. Schools using Emote can support 8x as many students, 12x earlier, ensuring staff have both the awareness and guidance to provide the right support at the right time. Our platform streamlines interventions by not only identifying students who need attention but also equipping staff with the next steps to maximize impact.
one_liner: Catch student behavior problems before they start.

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer: Emote is a school-wide collaboration tool, where anyone (e.g. receptionist, teacher, admin, parent, student) can share and discuss student emotional and behavioral observation. We convert this communication into real-time insight for schools to predict, support and evaluate both individual student and school needs.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Julian Golder is the founder of Emote, a platform that uses real-time data analysis to help educators and clinicians identify students who need support and provide tailored guidance. He gets most excited working on problems that augment human capacity to build and sustain stronger relationships. Before Emote, he opened and ran a school focused on deep differentiation, developed a national curriculum, and was an early hire at Wyzant, helping scale differentiated instruction to millions of student
